title: AI Potluck — how to delete your data
text: How to delete your data in AI Potluck: open Settings → Data & privacy and choose 'Forget everything…'. Settings is in the account menu, and the “Where it goes” pill under the message box also links to Data & privacy. It permanently deletes all of your conversations, your saved settings, and your usage records, and afterward tells you exactly what was removed. As a guest, 'Forget everything' is the only control you need — there's no account to delete from. If you signed in, you can also review linked sign-in methods and delete your account and its data from Account Settings at any time. Guest conversations are also deleted automatically after 30 days even if you do nothing.

title: AI Potluck — signing in with more than one method
text: Signing in to AI Potluck with more than one method: an email code opens the account that already uses that address, so someone who first signed in with Google, GitHub or Hugging Face and later uses an email code with the same address gets their existing account and chats. Signing in with a different provider on an address that already has an account, for example GitHub after Google or GitHub after an email code, is refused with "An account with this email already exists." To use it, sign in the way you originally did, then add it as another way in from Settings → Account. A passkey opens the account it was added to.
